decisions.question: Does CTOK001's cto_kernel.py already read CTOK_CHAIN_STATE.json?
decisions.evidence: find . -name '*cto_kernel*' → aucun fichier cto_kernel.py dans le dépôt (seul campaigns/RUN8/harness/vnext/factory_kernel.py : zone gelée, sémantique différente, non importable dans le runtime factory). grep -rn CTOK_CHAIN_STATE factory/ --include='*.py' → lecteur unique factory/hooks/stop_gate.py:60 (liste de fichiers figés, pas de lecture de capability_states). → BUILD d'un lecteur dédié factory/lib/required_state_resolver.py avec chemin injectable (défaut <repo>/factory/cto/CTOK_CHAIN_STATE.json).

decisions.question: Is there an existing dependency check in dispatcher_v3.py or factoryd.py?
decisions.evidence: grep -n dependency_mission_ids factory/bin/dispatcher_v3.py → l.273/279/288 : lu UNIQUEMENT pour l'injection de contexte (_prepare_context_package → context_compiler.compile), aucune vérification de capability_state. grep -n 'E2E_PROVEN' factory/bin/*.py factory/lib/*.py → zéro match runtime (seul CTOK_CHAIN_STATE.json contient ce vocabulaire). factoryd.py n'a ni _dispatch() ni _refill_slot() nommés ainsi — l'équivalent est la boucle de dispatch de do_poll_iteration (l.570-589 sur base 993955b4) : le point d'injection est AVANT worker = dispatch(mission_id, cs_path, run_dir) (l.582). → BUILD RequiredStateResolver + wiring gate avant dispatch, en réutilisant le mécanisme existant de skip no_plan (set + next non-bloquant) pour 'move to next in backlog'.

decisions.question: Should missing CTOK_CHAIN_STATE.json fail-closed or fail-open?
decisions.evidence: Invariant de sécurité (spec A4 : 'BLOCKED (fail-closed; do not dispatch without certainty)') + mission 'Always fail-CLOSED (security invariant)'. Registre manquant/corrompu + deps non vides → can_dispatch=False, toutes les deps dans missing_from_registry, reason=CHAIN_STATE_UNREADABLE. Cas limite deps=[] : can_dispatch=True car la formule spec (« can_dispatch = True iff both lists are empty ») le mandate et l'invariant CHILD_BASE_NOT_ACCEPTED n'est pas engagé sans deps (test_empty_deps_list_allows_dispatch).

decisions.question: Existing task-file parser (e.g. dispatcher_v3.py preflight)?
decisions.evidence: factory/bin/check_task.py:47-110 OUTCOME_MARKERS + _check_task_file — substring-based, OUTCOME only, would count '## Outcome' inside a code block (fails A1). check_task stays the dispatch-time preflight (different lifecycle); the enqueue-time validator reuses the marker philosophy but anchors headings (^##s+Name$) outside fenced code blocks and requires 3 sections (## Outcome, ## Deliverables, ## Depends On).

decisions.question: Injection point: rolling_backlog.py or factoryd.py?
decisions.evidence: rolling_backlog.py owns the queue (BacklogState.queued, append_queued, generate_next); factoryd dispatches FROM that queue — blocking at enqueue provably keeps missions out of factoryd active slots (A4). Constraint: public tests test_rolling_backlog.py (FD5_01..10, FD7_08..13) drive generate_next() with /fake/... nonexistent task_files, so enforcement there is opt-in (enforce_contract=False default preserves baseline). New strict gate: RollingBacklog.enqueue_mission() — validates before append, raises ContractViolationError, emits CTO event, increments counter.

decisions.question: Canonical ContractViolationError base class to extend?
decisions.evidence: grep repo-wide: only campaigns/RUN8/harness/vnext/ has a ContractViolation DATACLASS (different semantics, frozen zone, not importable in factory runtime). New exception built in factory/lib/task_contract_validator.py, carrying the ValidationResult violations list.
